findings.finding: sa_evaluate assigns experiment random seed to iteration, preventing the common frozen scenario protocol without source changes.
Tracking cost uses cost_tracking_raw multiplied by a nonlinear expression, whereas canonical ARGOS objective uses the frozen p90 softplus term; sharing constants alone does not align objectives.
Unconditional wandb logging and initialization require a separate logging/runtime protocol.

decision: Do not modify SA or present its native objective as a matched canonical-objective baseline. Preserve the predeclared representatives for a separately approved compatible baseline protocol.
